name: re_logDerivMean_one
summary: Modulo 1 the only character is trivial; L̃ of it is (s − 1)ζ(s), whose log-derivative at 1 is γ.

steps.claim: Unfold G_{d,1}(1) and ℓ(d): modulo 1 there is a single character, the trivial one, so Re G_{d,1}(1) = Re L̃′/L̃(1, 1·χ_d) − Re L̃′/L̃(1, 1) − 1 (φ(1) = 1), and ℓ(d) = γ − Re L̃′/L̃(1, 1·χ_d).
steps.lean:
simp [logDerivMean, chowlaSelbergConst, logDeriv, level_one, show @entireL 1 _ 1 = riemannZeta₁ by
    simp_all [entireL, Function.update_eq_iff, riemannZeta_eq_inv_sub_mul]]; ring

steps.claim: L̃(·, 1) for the trivial character modulo 1 is Mathlib's ζ₁ = `riemannZeta₁` (ζ₁(s) = 1 + (s − 1)ζ₀(s), ζ₀ the completion at s = 1 of ζ(s) − 1/(s − 1)): both functions are s ↦ (s − 1)ζ(s) for s ≠ 1 — L̃ by its definition (Mathlib's `LFunctionTrivChar₁ 1`, as L(s, 1) = ζ(s) modulo 1), ζ₁ because ζ(s) = (s − 1)⁻¹ζ₁(s) for s ≠ 1 — and both take the value 1 at s = 1 (L̃ the empty product ∏_{p∣1}(1 − 1/p) = 1, ζ₁(1) = 1).
steps.lean:
show @entireL 1 _ 1 = riemannZeta₁ by
    simp_all [entireL, Function.update_eq_iff, riemannZeta_eq_inv_sub_mul]

steps.claim: With L̃′/L̃(1, 1) = ζ₁′(1)/ζ₁(1) = γ/1 = γ (ζ₁(1) = 1 and ζ₁′(1) = γ are the simp lemmas `riemannZeta₁_one` and `deriv_riemannZeta₁_one` of Mathlib at the pin, ZetaAsymp.lean 572 and 599, which the simp call of step 1 uses), Re G_{d,1}(1) = Re L̃′/L̃(1, 1·χ_d) − γ − 1 = −1 − ℓ(d), by ring arithmetic.
